[{"insert":"Strict Bar Dip

The strict bar dip is your main chest and tricep press on Fridays. Keep your elbows tracking back instead of flaring wide, which keeps your shoulders safe and the load where you want it. The 31X1 tempo means three seconds down, a one second pause at the bottom, then drive up. Use as much assistance as you need to hit the reps at that tempo, then finish with a max unbroken set.
"}]
